title: Weekly digest of what waits on a human
summary: A scheduled workflow that opens one issue a week, assigned to the repository owner: pull requests to merge by hand, red or missing CI, failed or skipped scheduled runs, stale alert issues, overdue follow-ups.

CI_WORKFLOW.prompt: Name of the CI workflow that must be green before a merge (its `name:`)

postInstall: The digest has run live once, on the kit's own repository, and several of its sections have not (docs/conventions/weekly-digest.md § Status): once the workflow is on your default branch, run it by hand with dry_run ticked (Actions → Weekly digest → Run workflow) and read the run summary before trusting the schedule.
Check scripts/weekly-digest.config.mjs: the CI workflow name, and a maxAgeDays entry for every scheduled workflow that runs more often than weekly.
Track dated follow-ups as issues labelled `deadline` with a `Due: YYYY-MM-DD` line in the body; the digest picks them up.
